background: BNP Paribas Fortis is the largest bank in Belgium and the Belgian retail and commercial arm of BNP Paribas, funded by Belgian deposits and lending to households, companies and the public sector, with Turkish and Luxembourg subsidiaries.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and A2 from Moody's, all stable, and rest on the parent. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 13.5% is in the bottom quarter against a 16.4% median, while leverage of 7.1% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is the weak side, with LCR of 130% and NSFR of 109% both in the bottom quarter, well under medians of 151% and 124%. CET1 has risen 0.7 points and leverage 0.4 points since 30 Jun 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
